notes: Item 19 is fully present with 23 charts covering Flagship and Suite locations for the 2025 calendar year. Data extracted from Charts 1-15 (revenue and net revenue minus certain expenses) and Charts 16-23 (membership conversion and return on ad spend). Charts are for both franchised and corporate (affiliate-operated) locations combined or separately. 'Net Revenue Minus Certain Expenses' is not a standard net profit — it excludes brand fund contributions and Ad Management fees but includes most operating costs; mapped to 'net_profit' as closest available schema field. Membership conversion rate mapped to 'other'. Return on ad spend ratio mapped to 'other'. Some min/max values in Chart 5 appear internally inconsistent (e.g., HIGH % > LOW % for net revenue minus certain expenses %), likely due to small sample size or OCR; values transcribed as-is.
